steps: Begin by correcting progress.md within 600 words using the verified saved admission work, actual report outcomes and pending review. Preserve the current admission result unchanged in a new architecture-local versioned note before replacing result.md. Record the skeptical audit, execution deadline and at least 120 seconds reserved for checks and response. Do not repeat admission drafting or broad discovery.

Create uncertainty-measure-attachment-contract-v1.md and uncertainty-measure-attachment-fixtures-v1.json under docs/design/proposal/architecture/. Define a MeasureAttachmentRequest with immutable identity/version, exact family/view and model versions, declared joint coordinates/sample space, event representation, measure kind and purpose, support restrictions, dependence assumptions, provenance/justification, evidence/information cutoffs and dependencies. Define results separating structural validity, attachment disposition, mathematical obligations, empirical justification, capability support and permitted next operations.

Specify attachment invariants and failures: no probabilities from solver counts, labels or extraction confidence; no implicit independence; no mixing real-world and pricing measures; no attachment across incompatible family versions. A valid synthetic law may be attached as an explicit assumption without becoming empirically justified. Retain unweighted families and unresolved measure proposals. Changed family support invalidates reuse pending an explicit alignment or later update operation; never silently discard mass or renormalize.

Define event identity and evaluation against one declared joint measure. Distinguish named overlapping views from disjoint measurable cells and distinguish duplicate descriptions from distinct elementary outcomes that happen to share projected coordinates. Require coverage/disjointness evidence for finite partitions. State finite nonnegative unit-mass requirements and event union/intersection rules with short derivations. For continuous or mixed proposals, preserve the declared domain, measure representation and outstanding obligations; unsupported numerical evaluation returns no fabricated probability. Do not implement integration, conditioning or likelihood updates.

Save six fixture groups incrementally: unweighted-family preservation; a valid finite joint law and invalid mass/support variants; overlapping events; dependence ambiguity from identical marginals; family/version and measure-purpose mismatch; and a symbolic continuous proposal with unsupported evaluation. Use a declared three-atom law with masses 1/2, 1/3 and 1/6: events A={a,b} and B={b,c} have masses 5/6 and 1/2, intersection 1/3 and union 1. Include duplicated event labels, uncovered support and a projection that maps distinct outcomes to the same observed value. Each case supplies explicit inputs, expected disposition/reasons, preserved records and remaining obligations.

Compare two credible designs on the same fixtures: a family-linked measure record with event mappings, and a self-contained joint-model record with an explicit family projection. Explain identity, overlap, revision and portability tradeoffs; choose provisionally without selecting a library. Audit each material choice for provenance, justification, failure mode, smallest diagnostic and proposal status. Explain why the P04 finite atom representation is useful evidence but insufficient as the whole-product contract.

Define narrow interactions with admission, histories, time, persistence and future result contracts. An admission selection does not itself attach a law; attachment does not establish factual truth or accounting permission. Information cutoffs qualify justification and model inputs. Record the required interfaces for future conditioning/update tasks without specifying their complete algorithms. Explicitly reconcile unweighted innovations with the older core-contract restriction.

Add hashed references and a clearly partial measure-attachment work record to architecture.json. Preserve the three existing contract rows, all fourteen decisions, profile alternatives and wider mission obligations; keep uncertainty unfinished. Update result.md and progress.md with actual saved scope, every changed file, exact check outcomes and the next conditioning/update task. Do not edit runtime modules, tests, checker, controller, catalog or protected evidence.

Run bounded standard-library diagnostics that read fixture inputs to recompute rational totals, unions/intersections, overlap handling, support coverage and expected rejection conditions. Check JSON fields, unique identities and reference/hash integrity, then manually reconcile prose with fixtures. Save a fresh nonempty uncertainty-measure-attachment-consistency-check-v1.json. Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py --phase P16 --check once into a fresh architecture-local report, with a separate exit receipt. Investigate failures beyond the expected incomplete inventory; never overwrite previous reports.

Stop after the specification, six fixture groups, matched alternatives, partial architecture references, corrected checkpoint/result and actual diagnostics are saved. Return PARTIAL for P16 with exact remaining work. If the check reserve begins earlier, save completed sections and narrow the continuation. Do not expand into authority acquisition, probability updates, outcome execution or profile selection.
